The structure of Zn4Ag8As4 (reduced formula ZnAg2As) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Ag centers have 12 geometric neighbors (8 Ag, 2 As, 2 Zn), As centers have 12 Ag neighbors, and Zn centers have 12 Ag neighbors, with distances from 2.8948 to 2.9593 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ag-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between As- and Zn-centered polyhedra.
